extraction_notes: Output characteristics were digitized from Fig. 1 using the VGS = 5.0 V, 5.5 V, and 6.0 V traces; digitized values are approximate typical curve readings.
The datasheet publishes no transfer-characteristics figure and no capacitance-versus-VDS figure; neither was inferred.
The datasheet publishes no gate-charge or body-diode reverse-recovery data; neither was inferred.
Electrical-characteristics values are at TA = 25 degC unless a row specifies another junction or case temperature.
omission_reason: The supplied schema has no fields for off-state leakage, gate-body leakage, transconductance, switching delay, thermal ratings, absolute maximum ratings, or package data. The datasheet also lacks transfer, capacitance-versus-VDS, gate-charge, and reverse-recovery curves, so those quantities are omitted rather than estimated.
